title: UNA Watch app configuration fields
description: Schema for the 'configFile' and 'configFields' keys of an app's app-manifest.json. See Docs/app-config-fields.md. Other app-manifest.json keys are out of scope here and are not constrained. Two rules cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are enforced by validate_app_config.py instead: field ids must be unique within an app, and 'max' must be >= 'min' / 'maxLength' >= 'minLength' / 'default' must itself satisfy the field's constraints.

manifest_version.description: Version of the app-manifest.json format itself, not of the app. Must be 1. A reader that finds another value must refuse the manifest rather than guess at a format it was not built for.

configFile.description: Name of the values file the companion app writes into the app's directory on the watch. A bare filename in the sandbox root: no path separators, and never 'app-manifest.json'.

configFields.description: Ordered list of configuration fields the companion app asks the user to fill in. Array order is display order.

allOf.description: configFile is meaningless without fields to put in it.

id.description: Identifies the field in the values file and in app code. Stable for the life of the app: changing it discards the user's value.

label.description: Short human-readable name shown next to the input. Units belong in 'unit', not here.

fieldDescription.description: Longer human-readable explanation shown with the input.

required.description: true means the user must supply a value before the install can complete.

unit.description: Presentation-only suffix rendered after the input. Never part of the stored value.

validationMessage.description: Shown when the entered value fails any of this field's constraints. State the rule, e.g. 'Up to 16 letters, digits and spaces.'

minLength.description: Minimum length in UTF-8 bytes. 1 or more makes an empty value invalid.

maxLength.description: Maximum length in UTF-8 bytes, not characters. Mandatory: the app sizes its buffer from it.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match in full. Restricted dialect: no backreferences, no lookaround, no named groups, no inline flags, no Unicode property escapes. Do not write ^ or $ - matching is always anchored.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound. Mandatory: the app clamps to it.
Inclusive lower bound. Mandatory: the app clamps to it. Values are single-precision on the watch.
